display.purpose: Hero monetary figures only — today's revenue, checkout success amount. Never used for headings.

title1.purpose: Page titles (Events, POS, Inventory, Analytics, My).

body.purpose: Product names, list rows, form values, button labels.

caption.purpose: Timestamps, helper text, status-pill labels, stock counters.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Applied to every standalone card, session tile, and list-row container to signal 'this is a discrete surface' — never used for hover/press feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The app's single loudest gesture — full-width black CTA (建立場次, 結帳, 確認收款, 立即同步).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; width: 100%; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 24px; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paired secondary action next to a primary CTA (取消).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #E5E5EA; color: #000000; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; width: 100%; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 24px; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #D1D1D6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #C7C7CC; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Delete/remove actions (刪除場次). Never a solid red fill — the red lives only in the label.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #E5E5EA; color: #FF3B30; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; width: 100%; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 24px; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #D1D1D6; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3B30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill — Running
components.description: Signature component. The system's one semantic color signal: session is live right now.
components.css: .ds-pill-running { display: inline-block; background: #D8F5DE; color: #34C759; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Status Pill — Neutral
components.description: Completed/upcoming session state — muted gray, no semantic urgency.
components.css: .ds-pill-neutral { display: inline-block; background: #E5E5EA; color: #8E8E93; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Session Card
components.description: Standard card container — white surface on gray page background, whisper shadow, 24px radius.
components.html:
華山文創園區
今日 · 09:00 - 18:00

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #000000; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-subtitle { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #8E8E93; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-pill-running { display: inline-block; background: #D8F5DE; color: #34C759; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: List/Calendar toggle — capsule track, ink-filled selected segment.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; background: #E5E5EA; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-segment-item { border: none; background: transparent; color: #8E8E93; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment-item--active { background: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-segment-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Sheet form field — label above, Quiet Fill background, 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #8E8E93; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field-input { display: block; width: 100%; background: #E5E5EA; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 16px; color: #000000; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #000000; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Tilli is what a market vendor opens between customers, not a storefront they invite people to admire. The system reads like a plain paper ledger a stallholder keeps under the cash box: fast to scan, impossible to misread under bad tent lighting, and completely unconcerned with impressing anyone. Every surface is white or grouped-gray, every action is spoken in black ink, and the one splash of color in the whole app is reserved for the single fact a vendor actually needs to see at a glance — is this session live right now. This is a redesign target: it establishes the visual language shown in the reference mockups as the system going forward, superseding legacy screens and their blue/orange/purple accents rather than blending with them.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome by default: black, white, and two grays do almost all the work.
One semantic accent: green, used only to mean "running / positive," never decoratively.
Flat cards with barely-there shadows — depth is implied by fill, not lifted.
A tight, closed type scale (28 / 22 / 16 / 12) and an equally closed spacing scale (8 / 12 / 16 / 24).
Full-bleed black CTAs with generous 24pt rounding — the app's only "loud" gesture, and it's still just black.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "running," full stop. It never appears as a generic accent, link color, icon tint, or decorative highlight.

rules.name: The No-Blue Rule
rules.body: Interactive and selected states are communicated with a solid ink fill, not a colored accent. Blue does not appear anywhere in the chrome.

rules.name: The Four-Size Rule
rules.body: Every screen is composed from exactly four type sizes plus one Display cut. A fifth size means the layout needs restructuring, not a new token.

rules.name: The Whisper Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow opacity never exceeds 0.05. If a shadow is visible enough to describe, it's too strong.

dos: Do use solid ink (#000000) fill for every primary CTA and every "selected" state.
Do keep every corner at exactly 24px or 12px, every spacing gap at exactly 8/12/16/24px, and every type size at exactly 28/22/16/12px (plus the one 34px Display cut for money).
Do reserve green strictly for the "Running" status signal.
Do use SF Symbols in outline style everywhere; switch to .fill only to indicate a selected/active icon state.
Do separate sections with spacing and fill contrast, not Divider() lines.
donts: Don't use blue (or any color besides ink) as a button background or selected-state fill.
Don't let shadow opacity exceed 0.05, and never use a shadow to imply hover.
Don't introduce a second colored status pill or a second "meaning" for green.
Don't carry forward legacy blue/orange/purple accents, non-standard radii, or ad hoc font sizes from pre-redesign screens.
Don't use colored icons outside the Data Visualization exception.
